source: src/workflow/bpmnWellFormed.ts findXmlProblem; existing: scripts/test-workflow-tree-redesign.cjs (section on findXmlProblem)
title: findXmlProblem names the first breakage with a line number
scenario: Feed unterminated comment/CDATA/PI, mismatched closing tag, unclosed element, unquoted attribute, stray '<' and empty text. Also feed a valid BPMN containing '>' inside a quoted attribute and CDATA.
expected: Each broken input returns a message naming the problem and the correct 1-based line; valid inputs (incl. '>' in quotes) return undefined; empty text reports 'no XML element'.

source: src/workflow/bpmnModel.ts extractProcessModel; existing: scripts/test-workflow-bpmn-diagram.cjs, test-workflow-bpmn-diagnostics.cjs touch duplicates; offset preservation not asserted directly
title: Model reads only the first process and ignores comments and the DI block
scenario: Parse an XML with two processes reusing the same local ids, a commented-out serviceTask, and a BPMNDiagram block carrying bpmnElement refs.
expected: Nodes and flows come only from the first process; no phantom duplicates from the second process, comment or DI block; reported offsets still index the original text.

source: src/workflow/bpmnModel.ts unescapeXml / attribute; existing: scripts/test-workflow-input-trust.cjs and test-workflow-bpmn-diagram.cjs cover rewriteProcessIdentity escaping and CDATA conditions only
title: Attribute escapes decode once, in the right order
scenario: Parse a process named 'a &lt; b <c> "q"'; also use single-quoted attributes and activiti: prefix vs default namespace for class.
expected: name decodes to 'a < b <c> "q"' (no double unescape); single and double quotes both read; prefixed and unprefixed class attributes yield the same value.

source: src/workflow/bpmnDiagnostics.ts analyseBpmn; existing: scripts/test-workflow-bpmn-diagnostics.cjs covers most codes; missing-process-id, missing-flow-id and gateway-outgoing-flows assertions unverified
title: Diagnostic code and severity set is stable
scenario: Run analyseBpmn over a fixture per code: not-executable, id-filename-mismatch, missing-process-id, duplicate-id, missing-flow-id, missing-/unresolved-endpoint, gateway-outgoing-flows, gateway-no-default, default-flow-*, user-task-listeners, unknown-class, no-diagram, plane-mismatch, no-shape.
expected: Each fixture yields exactly its code with the documented severity and a range inside the document; a clean skeleton from buildBpmnSkeleton yields no errors.

title: Required task listeners differ for potentialMatchReview vs dataChangeRequestReview
scenario: Analyse a built-in review process id with the DCR listener, the entity listener, and none; then a custom id with each.
expected: Entity listener satisfies potentialMatchReview only, DCR listener satisfies dataChangeRequestReview only, custom ids accept either, and missing listener is flagged for all three.

title: Diagnostics manager derives process id from the file name and refreshes on change
scenario: With the vscode stub, open a document named foo.bpmn20.xml whose process id is bar, update, then edit the id to foo and update again.
expected: First update publishes id-filename-mismatch; second clears it; documents that are not .bpmn20.xml are ignored; dispose clears the collection.

source: src/workflow/bpmnLayout.ts layoutProcess; existing: scripts/test-workflow-bpmn-diagram.cjs layout sections; orphan-boundary fallback not verified
title: Boundary events sit on their host; unresolved attachedToRef still gets a position
scenario: Layout a process with a boundaryEvent attached to a task, and another whose attachedToRef names a missing node, each with a flow in/out.
expected: Attached event bounds touch the host edge and are not passed to ELK; the orphan boundary event still has bounds; flows touching them get straight-line waypoints, no exception.

title: Nothing is drawn for a process with no id or no nodes; generator replaces an existing diagram
scenario: Call generateDiagramSection on XML with no process id, on one with zero flow nodes, and withGeneratedDiagram on a valid one that already has a BPMNDiagram.
expected: The first two return undefined and the XML is untouched; the third yields exactly one BPMNDiagram with a plane for the process id and a shape per node.

title: Environment names normalise to the same registry row
scenario: Look up 'EU-1', 'https://eu-1.reltio.com/', 'eu-1.reltio.com' and aliases for a known environment; look up an unknown name and a label listed twice.
expected: Case, scheme, trailing path and domain suffix all resolve to the same {kind:'url'} host; unknown returns undefined; duplicate listings return {kind:'ambiguous'} with candidates.

title: No environment label resolves two different ways
scenario: Iterate knownEnvironmentLabels(); for each, call lookupWorkflowAdapterUrl and compare against the bundled table.
expected: Every label returns exactly one url or an explicit ambiguous result; every returned host is accepted by toHttpsBase.

title: Errors map to actions by class and status, not by message text
scenario: Classify ReltioApiError 401, 403 (deploy/register/fetch), 404 on deploy vs fetch, 429 with and without retryAfterSeconds, WorkflowConnectionError, UntrustedHostError, plain Error.
expected: 401 reauthenticate; 403 names ROLE_WORKFLOW_MANAGER for deploy/register; deploy 404, connection and untrusted-host errors offer Edit Adapter URL; 429 only quotes a real retry-after; others plain message.

title: Deploy decision reads the id inside the XML
scenario: planDeploy with deployed list undefined, XML without id, invalid id, id differing from file name, id already deployed, built-in id (authoring) and generic:true match; then describeDeploy on each.
expected: Undefined list and bad ids refuse with a message; mismatch, replacesLive, replacesBuiltIn flags are correct; modal text names the XML id and the tenant and picks 'Deploy new version' only when replacing.

title: Sync badge ignores only CRLF and BOM differences
scenario: Compare identical XML with CRLF vs LF, with a leading BOM, with a changed attribute, and with an extra trailing space.
expected: CRLF/BOM-only differences give 'clean'; attribute or whitespace changes give 'changed'.

title: Content provider keeps at most 50 entries and fires change on re-store
scenario: Store 60 distinct processes, read the oldest and newest URIs; store the same URI twice and listen to onDidChange; read an unknown URI.
expected: Oldest entries are evicted, newest are served; second store fires onDidChange once; unknown URI returns the 'content unavailable' placeholder.

source: src/workspace/workflowRepoOrigin.ts planRepoCleanup; existing: scripts/test-workflow-tree-redesign.cjs covers kept-modified and baseline pairing; unsafe-path filtering not verified
title: Cleanup plan never includes unsafe or user-owned paths
scenario: planRepoCleanup with tracked paths '../x', '/abs', 'C:/x', '.git/config', a modified file, an unpushed file, an ignored target/ file, an ignored .env, and a baseline whose BPMN is kept.
expected: Unsafe paths are dropped; modified/unpushed go to keptModified; target/ files are removed; .env stays; a baseline is removed only with its owning BPMN.

title: Tenant, draft and repository rows merge in a fixed order with repo state
scenario: Merge definitions, local drafts and repo files where ids overlap and differ in content.
expected: Order is deployed, drafts, repo; overlapping ids collapse per the documented rules; repo row states notDeployed/differs/same/deployed/unknown are assigned correctly.

title: Local BPMN state pairs each file with its baseline
scenario: In memory fs, create a.bpmn20.xml with identical baseline, b.bpmn20.xml with edited text vs baseline, c.bpmn20.xml with no baseline, and notes.txt.
expected: Result lists a, b, c sorted by id; hasLocalChanges false/true/false (c is a draft with baselineText undefined); notes.txt ignored; a missing directory returns [].

title: Drafts are never overwritten and list tolerates unreadable files
scenario: In memory fs, write a draft, write the same file name again; list a folder with a valid draft, a non-draft file and a draft whose read throws.
expected: Second write rejects with 'already exists' and the first content is intact; list returns only drafts sorted by id, with processName undefined when unreadable.

title: Connecting merges the clone without losing drafts
scenario: Existing Workflows/ has generated README, bpmn/mine.bpmn20.xml and baseline; staging holds pom.xml, README, bpmn/in-repo, mod/, .git.
expected: Generated README replaced, drafts kept, repo BPMN merged into bpmn/, .git moved, baseline pattern added to .git/info/exclude, no .gitignore created.

title: Adoption conflict changes nothing
scenario: User-written README.md and a module folder that the clone also contains.
expected: Throws WorkflowRepoAdoptionConflictError listing README.md and mod; snapshot of the filesystem is identical before and after.

source: src/workspace/workflowRepoConnect.ts adoptStagedRepository; existing: scripts/test-workflow-tree-redesign.cjs has adoption sections near lines 606-658; rollback path not verified
title: A failed move is rolled back and the generated README restored
scenario: Make fs.rename fail on the second move (stub), after the generated README was deleted and one entry moved.
expected: Moved entries are renamed back, the README text is rewritten, error propagates, staging still holds the unmoved items, user drafts untouched.

title: Disconnect removes only clean repository files
scenario: Fake git outputs: tracked, one modified, one with unpushed commit, ignored target/, plus an untracked new draft; run planRepoCleanup then removeRepoFiles.
expected: Clean tracked files and target/ output are deleted; modified, unpushed and untracked drafts remain; the confirmation text reports counts of kept and unpushed.

title: Bulk download never replaces an existing file
scenario: Plan for ids ['a','B','b','bad/id','con'] with a.bpmn20.xml on disk and only a baseline for another id.
expected: a is alreadyOnDisk; B and b collapse to one download (case-insensitive); invalid ids are unusable; a lone baseline does not block its id.

source: src/extension.ts bulk download wiring (loaders); existing: scripts/test-workflow-bulk-download.cjs asserts the wiring structurally only
title: Opening the Process Definitions list downloads missing BPMN without blocking
scenario: Manual (Tier C): against a real tenant with 100+ definitions and one locally edited download, expand Process Definitions.
expected: List renders before downloads finish; missing files appear in Workflows/bpmn; the edited file is untouched; failures stop after repeated 401 with one notice. Wiring lives in extension.ts, so it is manual.

source: src/workspace/workflowRepoGitignore.ts reconcileWorkflowRepoGitignore; existing: scripts/test-custom-workflow-repository.cjs, test-workflow-input-trust.cjs cover injection cases; reconcileAll error isolation not verified
title: Nested repo is gitignored in the outer tenant repo in either connect order
scenario: Tenant with outer .git and sidecar relativePath Workflows: run reconcile twice; then with no outer .git; then with no sidecar.
expected: Entry 'Workflows/' is added once (idempotent); the other two cases write nothing; reconcileAll continues after one tenant throws.

source: src/workspace/workflowRepoDiscovery.ts discoverBpmnFilesDetailed; existing: scripts/test-workflow-review-fixes.cjs (2001-file cap); other skips only in test-custom-workflow-repository.cjs
title: Discovery skips build output, big files and caps the candidate count
scenario: Repo with src/main/resources/a.xml, target/classes/a.xml, node_modules/x.xml, a 2 MB .xml, a schema .xml with no process id, a .baseline.xml, nesting 12 deep; and 2001 candidates.
expected: Only a.xml under src is returned with its pom module; skipped dirs, oversized, id-less and baseline files are ignored; depth over 10 is not walked; 2001 candidates set truncated true.

title: Saved sidecar URL never keeps https credentials
scenario: storableRepoUrl for https://user:tok@host/r.git, http with user only, and git@host:org/r.git; toOpenableHttpsUrl for https, ssh, file:, javascript:.
expected: https/http lose userinfo; ssh keeps git@; only https URLs are openable, with username stripped; other schemes return undefined.

title: Sidecar relativePath cannot escape the tenant or inject gitignore rules
scenario: Validate '..\x', 'a/../b', '/abs', 'C:\x', 'a\nb', '!x', '#x', 'Workflows'.
expected: All hostile values return a problem string and loadWorkflowRepoConfig returns undefined with a reason; 'Workflows' is accepted.

title: Server-supplied ids cannot become unsafe file names
scenario: Check ids with '/', '\', '..', trailing dot, NUL, Windows device names (con, NUL, com1) in any case, 200+ chars, and an id from a mocked adapter listing.
expected: All are rejected with a validation message; processIdFromBpmnFileName returns undefined for them; planBulkDownload marks them unusable.

title: Adapter calls refuse redirects, stalls and oversized bodies
scenario: Stub fetch to redirect, stall mid-body, return a huge streaming body, and 429 with Retry-After on listAvailableJars.
expected: redirect:'error' is passed; stalled body rejects within the timeout; oversized body is rejected and the stream cancelled; Retry-After is preserved and 10089 maps to notConfigured.

title: Hostile BPMN text cannot stall the extension host
scenario: Run extractProcessModel, findXmlProblem and analyseBpmn on 2 MB inputs: 100k unterminated '<!--', 100k '<process ' with no '>', a 1 MB attribute value, deep nesting, and a DOCTYPE with entity declarations.
expected: Every call returns without throwing within a generous budget (for example 2 s each); no entity is expanded; a DOCTYPE does not change the parsed model.

title: Analysis scales to a 2000-node process
scenario: Generate a process with 2000 serviceTasks chained by flows and a few gateways; time extractProcessModel and analyseBpmn.
expected: Both finish under a generous budget (for example 3 s); node and flow counts equal the generated numbers; no finding is reported for a valid chain.

title: Layout completes for a 300-node process and keeps every node and flow
scenario: Generate 300 chained tasks with 20 exclusive gateways and boundary events; call layoutProcess and generateDiagramSection.
expected: Promise resolves within a generous budget (for example 15 s); bounds exist for every node, waypoints for every routable flow; the section parses and passes isCompleteFor.

title: Bulk run honors the concurrency limit and aborts on repeated failures
scenario: Run 500 items with limit 4 and a worker tracking in-flight count; then a worker that always throws with abortAfterConsecutiveFailures 5; then cancel mid-run.
expected: In-flight never exceeds 4; all 500 processed; failing run stops after 5 failures with aborted true; cancel stops starting new items.

title: Webview renders BPMN names as text, never markup
scenario: Manual (Tier C): open a BPMN whose process name, task names, flow labels and documentation contain and
expected: Labels, tooltips, header and status line show the literal text; no script runs. Source uses textContent at every document-derived sink (bpmnView.ts lines 191-356, 480).
